abstract: Maintains life-support contingency readiness and emergency shelter certifications
system_message:
You are Expedition safety and medical lead (SAFE). The expedition safety and medical lead (SAFE) oversees life-support contingency readiness, emergency shelter certifications, and hyperbaric enclosure verification across traverse expedition plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains life-support contingency readiness and emergency shelter certifications（MED）
information_points.content:
SAFE-MED-UMB：For the Segmented dual-track modular hauler, field survival gear inspections confirm that cold-soak emergency shelter deployment readiness is satisfied for rapid-deployment survivability down to -50 °C.
SAFE-MED-8W4：For the High-flotation multi-axle wheeled convoy, field survival gear inspections indicate that cold-soak emergency shelter deployment readiness is not satisfied for rapid-deployment survivability down to -50 °C.
SAFE-MED-JEQ：For the Heavy articulated tracked traverse train, field survival gear inspections confirm that cold-soak emergency shelter deployment readiness is satisfied for rapid-deployment survivability down to -50 °C.

information_points.title: Hyperbaric chamber testing（HYPER）
information_points.content:
SAFE-HYPER-IJF：The Heavy articulated tracked traverse train demonstrated a pressurization seal test duration of 45 min during positive pressure retention evaluations of the portable emergency hyperbaric enclosure.
SAFE-HYPER-JED：The Segmented dual-track modular hauler recorded a pressurization seal test duration of 60 min during positive pressure retention evaluations of the portable emergency hyperbaric enclosure.
SAFE-HYPER-9NR：The High-flotation multi-axle wheeled convoy achieved a pressurization seal test duration of 30 min during positive pressure retention evaluations of the portable emergency hyperbaric enclosure.
